03

AI image tools (Coverly, BustDown, PeelPix)

Repo

Developer

Three image apps built on generative models: mixtape covers, style transforms, and a plain-language photo editor.

A small family of AI image apps. Coverly generates mixtape cover art, BustDown turns a photo into viral-style edits, and PeelPix edits and restores photos from natural-language instructions. All built with Vite, React, and TypeScript on Gemini image models.

Stack

  • Vite / React
  • TypeScript
  • Gemini
